hypothesis: A different frozen backbone may add complementary information on the repaired compact90 raw-mixed feature view. Earlier TabICL runs used generic Processor output and56k3fold, so they do not establish this matched comparison.
methods: TabICLv2 supports mixed DataFrames, full context and memory offloading. One fixed8estimator configuration; same corrected Kumo split and correction/spline architecture for comparison.
primary: Frozen TabICLv2 on compact90 versus repaired frozen Kumo90. Same50000context/6000head/14000evaluation split in each of five folds.
secondary: Predeclared80percent Kumo control and20percent TabICL pipeline probability blend; no weight tuning.
